import pathlib,subprocess
names=[]
for raw in subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--porcelain=v1','-z','--untracked-files=all','--','results/']).split(b'\0'):
 if not raw:continue
 p=raw[3:].decode()
 if not p.startswith('results/_archive/') and p.endswith('.json') and pathlib.Path('logs/runs',pathlib.Path(p).stem+'.meta.json').is_file(): names.append(p)
assert names
raise SystemExit(subprocess.call(['python3','scripts/audit_provenance.py',*names]))
